course_name_original: UE Physique pour le génie électrique
syllabus_topics: Electrostatics: Basic quantities associated with static charge distributions
Coulomb force and Electric field (Symmetry rules, continuity properties, Electric field flux (field tube, Gauss's theorem)
Energy properties (Work of the electric force, Potential energy and potential function, Energy of a charge distribution)
Electrical conductors (Shielding, Field at the surface and Electrostatic Pressure, Capacities and influence coefficients: application to capacitors)
Magnetostatics: Study of magnetic fields produced by current circulations (stationary) or permanent magnetizations
Symmetry properties of the magnetostatic field
Laws for calculating magnetic field (Biot and Savart, Ampère's theorem) and their application in simple cases for analytical calculations
Magnetic materials and concepts of magnetic circuits, F.E.M, magnetic energy, and forces of magnetic origin
Wave Propagation: Description and understanding of wave propagation, particularly electromagnetic wave propagation
Propagation in different media: vacuum, plasma, dielectric, metal
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Électronique-Énergie électrique-Automatique (UGA)
degree: Licence Électronique, énergie électrique, automatique, parcours EEA (2e et 3e année)
